描述_EN: the central part of the band is decorated with a network of geometric motifs set against a red background, and features blue frame borders. the tapestry square, added by sewing to the linen ground cloth, features stylized plant motifs. it's difficult to say exactly which part of the garment this piece of canvas belonged to, as it can't be laid flat. fragment of canvas probably from a tunic with polychrome tapestry pieces added by sewing (band and medallion). a red braided cord seems to indicate the presence of a border.
描述_ZN: 带子的中央部分装饰着红色背景上的几何图案网络，并配有蓝色的边框。 挂毯方块，通过缝制添加到亚麻底布上，具有风格化的植物图案。 很难说这块布具体属于衣服的哪一部分，因为不可能把它平放。 可能来自一件外衣的帆布碎片，上面缝有多色挂毯（带子和奖章）。 一条红色的编织绳似乎表明有一个边界。
时期: 埃及 拜占庭统治时期
